versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Vehicle Certificate Recognition and Extraction Skill based on Laiye ADP.
- Supports accurate extraction of 30+ key fields from vehicle certificate images/scans, outputting structured JSON.
- Provides ready-to-use CLI integration with zero configuration; suitable for vehicle registration, used car trading, and asset management.
- Includes step-by-step instructions for installation, API key configuration, application selection, field extraction, and batch/async operations.
- New users receive 100 free monthly credits, equivalent to extraction of 200 certificates each month.
